operation: cumulative game-process CPU and I/O counters at AppID startup milestones

design.window_note: Window metrics are explicitly labeled as stability-confirmation samples, five seconds after first sighting.

recall.query: Steam AppID startup timer proc pid io stat CPU ticks read_bytes milestone attribution

claim_boundary: Host behavior only. Tablet deltas must decide whether the pre-graphics and graphics intervals are CPU, storage, or wait dominated.
